mcat_description.short: Mild Steel Portable House is a prefabricated, relocatable dwelling or cabin unit built on a mild steel structural frame, factory-manufactured and delivered as a complete or knock-down assembly for rapid on-site installation.
mcat_description.long: A Mild Steel Portable House is a modular, relocatable structure manufactured from precision-welded mild steel frames and panels, designed for quick deployment without permanent foundation work. These units are supplied in standard sizes (typically 10 ft to 40 ft length) or custom dimensions, and typically include insulated wall panels, waterproof roofing, electrical fittings, doors, and windows as a ready-to-use package. They serve a wide range of applications — from single-room site offices and security cabins to multi-room 1BHK residential units with bathroom and kitchen — and are widely used across construction sites, industrial campuses, agricultural land, and disaster-relief deployments. In the Indian B2B market, sellers quote both per-unit (for standard catalogue sizes) and per-square-foot (for custom-dimension orders), with the structural steel frame typically conforming to IS 2062 mild steel specifications.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, Mild Steel Portable Houses are prefabricated, relocatable structures built on IS 2062-grade mild steel frames, manufactured by a large base of SME fabricators concentrated in Hyderabad, Jaipur, Bengaluru, and NCR. The product is commercially distinct from GI panel, FRP, and PUF portable houses — which are sibling MCATs — by virtue of the heavier, more durable MS structural frame that suits longer-term deployment and heavier-use applications. Standard commercial sizes range from 10 ft to 40 ft in length, with 10×15 ft and 10×20 ft being the most commonly searched configurations per keyword data. Buyers typically receive a complete turnkey unit including insulated wall panels, waterproof roof, electrical fittings, doors, and windows, with installation and AMC offered by larger manufacturers. The structural steel used in these units is expected to conform to BIS IS 2062 (hot-rolled structural steel) standards, and prefabricated building design follows IS 15916 / IS 15917 codes for systems building. Key buyer segments include construction contractors (site offices, labour housing), individual residential buyers (affordable 1BHK housing), agricultural landowners (farmhouse/watchman quarters), and government/NGO procurement for disaster relief. The market uses both 'portable house' and 'portable cabin' interchangeably; 'MS container cabin' and 'portacabin' are also widely used trade terms. Tata Steel Nest-In (MobiNest) is a recognised organised-sector brand; the majority of supply comes from unorganised MSME fabricators (single source — low confidence for brand claim).
